subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers review or adopt the open fork closing PR for this Anthropic OAuth header bug, or close it and queue a same-repository repair against the direct transport path?
rationale: The source-level bug shape is narrow, but this issue is paired with an open conflicting fork PR that uses closing syntax, and opening another repair without maintainer direction would create competing fix paths.

options.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR as the active candidate if it can be refreshed and proven against current direct Anthropic transport behavior.

options.title: Close fork, queue repair
options.body: Close the stale fork candidate and let ClawSweeper make a same-repository fix focused on preserving OAuth-required betas across model-level header merging.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the open fork PR as the active candidate if it can be refreshed and proven against current direct Anthropic transport behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current direct transport/header merge implementation is locally blamed to this recent area work, making it the best routing candidate for the remaining source path.
